intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, and both are listed with CAT. This page compares recorded fees, placements and NIRF ranks from our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.

KIIT Bhubaneswar vs XIMB is not a close brand fight. XIM University's MBA-BM is a fully residential management programme with a higher official fee and a better NIRF 2025 Management rank on our records.

sections.heading: KIIT Bhubaneswar vs XIMB for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose XIMB if you want the flagship MBA in Business Management at Xavier Institute of Management, XIM University, with a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 45 and a 2024 MBA-HRM record of ₹20 lakh average and ₹30 lakh highest.
Choose KIIT if you want a university MBA at the recorded year tuition of ₹1.25 lakh, with a 2023 entrepreneurship record of ₹6 lakh average and ₹12 lakh highest, after you confirm the official fee.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: For KIIT we hold ₹1.25 lakh as MBA tuition for one year, plus ₹600 admission and ₹2,000 security rows. Do not quote the ₹600 admission fee as the programme cost.
Confirm the official KIIT fee notice, because a year tuition of ₹1.25 lakh may not be the full published total.
For XIMB our table shows ₹9.65 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for MBA Business Management and MBA Human Resource Management. Executive MBA rows of ₹14 lakh are not the flagship two-year programmes.

XIM University's official 2026 fee page lists an MBA-BM course fee of ₹11.50 lakh in each of the two years, plus a ₹1 lakh development fund and other listed heads. Use that official breakdown rather than only our ₹9.65 lakh row.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: XIMB has a 2024 MBA Human Resource Management row of ₹20 lakh average and ₹30 lakh highest. That is a historical record, not a promise.
There is also a 2023 executive MBA row with a ₹72 lakh highest. Do not compare that executive figure as if it were the flagship MBA-BM or MBA-HRM.
KIIT has a 2023 MBA Entrepreneurship row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹12 lakh highest. Ask both placement cells for the latest official, programme-specific report.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both sides are listed with CAT. Follow the official XIM University and KIIT admissions pages for other accepted tests, interviews and eligibility.
On our records, XIMB has a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 45, and KIIT has a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 68. Confirm the current list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, so a local student can visit them without leaving the city.
XIMB, under XIM University, is a residential management campus. KIIT is a large multi-discipline private university. The classroom mix and campus life will not feel the same.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick XIMB if the official 2026 MBA-BM fee, the NIRF 2025 Management rank of 45, and the 2024 recorded average of ₹20 lakh fit your plan.
Pick KIIT if a university MBA at the recorded ₹1.25 lakh year tuition, once confirmed officially, is the better budget fit.
Do not compare an executive highest package with a flagship MBA average, and do not treat the ₹600 KIIT admission fee as tuition.

faqs.question: What is the official MBA-BM fee at XIM University for 2026?
faqs.answer: The official 2026 fee page lists an MBA-BM course fee of ₹11.50 lakh in each of the two years, plus a ₹1 lakh development fund and other listed heads. Our table still shows a ₹9.65 lakh year total, so use the official breakdown.

faqs.question: What MBA fee is on record for KIIT?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹1.25 lakh as tuition for one year, plus ₹600 admission and ₹2,000 security rows. The ₹600 amount is not tuition. Confirm the official KIIT notice for the current total.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: XIMB has a 2024 MBA-HRM row of ₹20 lakh average and ₹30 lakh highest. KIIT has a 2023 entrepreneurship row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹12 lakh highest. Do not use the 2023 executive MBA highest of ₹72 lakh as a flagship figure.

faqs.question: Which college has the better NIRF 2025 Management rank?
faqs.answer: On our records, XIMB is at 45 and KIIT is at 68. Confirm the official NIRF 2025 Management list if you need the exact listing.

faqs.question: Do both programmes accept CAT?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are listed with CAT. Check the official admissions pages for other accepted tests and interview rules.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Bhubaneswar?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, though XIMB is a residential management campus and KIIT is a larger multi-discipline university.
